acceptanceCriteria: internal/doccorpus, internal/companionrelease and conformance/release-artifact-v0 tests read committed content from a disposable fixture repository instead of the enclosing checkout, with existing assertions preserved.
corvint affected with an unrelated dirty path no longer selects each fixed package through UNBOUNDED_READER, retained in a build-log entry with the measured per-merge saving.
body:
Found 2026-10-01 while re-attributing the AFP-V0-023 16-merge replay (V1-0246). These root-locating test packages run git against the real checkout (for example doccorpus TestCorpusSelfDocumentation), so the AFP-V0-023 Landlock wrapper, which denies .git, cannot confine them and they stay on the unbounded-reader floor for every change (doccorpus about 168 package-seconds per merge). PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/449 shows the fix pattern for internal/behaviorfalsify: commit synthetic copies of the needed paths to a t.TempDir() repository with an isolated git environment. Expected: each package selected only by its own sources and dependencies. Actual: selected on every dirty path.

2026-10-01 doccorpus done (PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/452, merged into the PR438 branch claude/ci-affected-selection at b6e38e47): TestCorpusSelfDocumentation moved to internal/doccorpus/selfcorpus (a deliberate root locator, about 8-17 s), and internal/doccorpus declares examples/documentation-corpus/; 315 per-test outcomes identical confined vs unconfined in golang:1.27.1 (Landlock ABI 4). Remaining: internal/companionrelease (reads the checkout's .git) and conformance/release-artifact-v0 (lists the top-level .agent-evidence directory) still need hermetic fixtures. Evidence docs/build-log/2026-10-01-declared-floor-read-scopes.md; CEMs .corvint/changes/1297f25dad635a4434636d6b9429d9a97efad94b.cem.json and c38e6836158a79d325736e3b8c5def9c4efb9705.cem.json (check PASS, sealed).
title: tests: give doccorpus, companionrelease and release-artifact-v0 hermetic git fixtures so they leave the affected floor
